dedupe_keys.name: saudi ministry of environment water and agriculture daily dam bulletin storage water level and gate status per dam

description: The Water Agency of Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) publishes a daily dam bulletin as a PDF. MEWA produced the bulletins; the one read for 13-4-1448 AH runs to six pages and lists, for each dam by region, the storage capacity, spillway height, previous and current storage, water level, change in storage, the status of the discharge gates and the current storage as a percentage of capacity, for dams such as King Fahd, Baysh, Jazan and Tabalah. Coverage is the dams in the bulletin across Saudi Arabia. The bulletins are free downloads on the MEWA site, dated in the Hijri calendar; no licence is stated. Caveats: the tables are PDFs in Arabic with Arabic-Indic digits and the page lists bulletins one day at a time, so building a series means parsing many files. Simulation uses: daily reservoir storage and gate operation for flood and drought response and water supply planning in an arid country. Related records: the AQUASTAT georeferenced dams (data-fao-aquastat-georeferenced-dams) and the K-water dam data (data-korea-kwater-dam-weir-hydrological-operation-data).
